threat_event: UM model recommendation drives an adverse medical necessity outcome without documented individualized clinical review
threat_source: AI model use without adequate oversight
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clinician review documentation incomplete (11 of 60 sampled cases); model not presented to the UM committee
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D2 UM platform and AI UM model
existing_controls: Model never issues denials; physician reviews potential adverse decisions
treatment_plan: Structured reviewer rationale fields; UM committee approval of model use; monthly audit of 30 cases (P10)

threat_event: Health Plan PHI on the Group Data Platform is used or exposed beyond its permitted purpose
threat_source: Insider or external attacker using over-broad platform roles
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mixed zones; purpose-based access inconsistent; Health Plan inheritance of platform controls not documented
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G3 Group Data Platform (Health Plan zone)
treatment_plan: Zone separation and purpose tags (group plan GR-01)

threat_event: Ransomware halts the claims core and enrollment processing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Claims core in colocation data center; recovery relies on tape-to-disk restore tested once a year
existing_controls: Group EDR and SOC; immutable backups
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests of the claims core; documented manual claims pend process

threat_event: Health Plan relies on group common controls that are not documented or verified as inherited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common control inheritance documented for Care Delivery but not for the Health Plan
treatment_plan: Health Plan inheritance matrix and customer-side responsibilities (P02 catalog)
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: Outdated Health Plan security standards permit weaker practices than group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Health Plan standards last aligned in 2024 (90-day log retention; SMS codes allowed on the broker portal)
treatment_plan: Re-align Health Plan supplement to 2026 group policies (P06)
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: Broker portal account takeover exposes member PHI and redirects commissions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SMS one-time codes allowed; 4,200 broker accounts
regulatory_driver: N62-R01 (164.312(d)); N52-R07 (state insurance data security laws)
treatment_plan: Authenticator app or passkeys for brokers
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: Social engineering changes a provider's payment account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Provider data changes verified by call-back only above a dollar threshold

threat_event: Breach at a delegated vendor exposes member data
treatment_plan: Continuous vendor monitoring for tier 1 vendors

threat_event: State insurance regulator notice missed in a shared-service incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Multi-regulator matrix not exercised; adopting-state list not maintained
treatment_plan: Maintain adopting-state list; exercise the matrix (P08)

threat_event: UM model auto-approval rates differ across age or disability groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No subgroup monitoring of auto-approval rates
treatment_plan: Quarterly subgroup analysis reported to the UM committee

threat_event: Enrollment file sent to the wrong employer group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual file routing for 30 small groups

threat_event: Workforce member views records of members who are public figures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monitoring covers claims but not care management notes

threat_event: Caller impersonates a member to obtain PHI from the call center
treatment_plan: One-time code to the member's registered phone

threat_event: Third-party apps abuse member data access APIs
treatment_plan: Automated anomaly alerts on API usage

threat_event: Care Delivery data disclosed to the Health Plan exceeds the minimum necessary
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standard data feeds between divisions not reviewed against purpose
treatment_plan: Minimum-necessary protocol for each routine feed (group plan GR-01)

threat_event: Unsupported middleware on the claims core is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Middleware out of vendor support since 2025

threat_event: Hurricane closes the claims operations center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One operations center in a coastal city
treatment_plan: Accepted: remote work covers the risk; residual Low
